youtube.baslik: Can a bone conduction threshold fall below zero decibels? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In superior canal dehiscence, an opening in the superior semicircular canal creates a third window in the inner ear. In this example, masked bone conduction reaches minus 10 dB at low frequencies, and an air-bone gap appears despite a normal middle ear; unlike otosclerosis, the acoustic reflex is usually present.
